Theorem
[Weighted flat-boundary estimate]1. ch4:4.12,ch4:4.29,ch4:4.30\group ch04-poisson-newtonian-potential Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0078 If $\Delta u=f$ in $\Omega \subset \mathbb R^n_+$, $u=0$ on $T$, and $f\in C^\alpha (\Omega \cup T)$, then \begin{equation} \tag {4.30} |u|^*_{2,\alpha ;\Omega \cup T} \leq C\bigl(|u|_{0;\Omega }+|f|^{(2)}_{0,\alpha ;\Omega \cup T}\bigr), \qquad C=C(n,\alpha ). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 23 on half-balls of radius comparable to $d_x$, and separate nearby from distant pairs as in Theorem 18.

□
